records.title: SHAKE squeeze: swap the byte pairs of a whole lane with one AND and a field product, then peel candidates with bounded divisions
Keccak-f rotations as bounded-integer multiply, divide and add: only the split at bit 64 is checked (on top of the lane byte-swap squeeze)
chi complements as a bounded 2^128-1-b, exact for every u128 so check-free, ANDed with a 64-bit lane (on top of bounded rotations and the lane byte-swap)
Keccak-f on a packed state: two lanes per u128 (rows 0-1, rows 2-3) so theta and chi take one bitwise call per lane pair, lanes split only for rho
Hint and norm checks as bounded-int arithmetic: a*b+(6q-c) and (a-b+6144) mod q with one bounded division each, no checked u16/u32 ops (on top of the packed Keccak)
SHAKE candidates: one bounded division gives both the 5q rejection (quotient 5) and the residue, and blocks that cannot fill 512 skip the cap check
Packed Keccak-f with twelve rounds per loop iteration: two loop passes instead of 24, account class still well under the size limit
Hint check on the unreduced NTT of the hint: the transform's outputs stay below 2^122, so a*b + K - c is reduced once in the check instead of 512 output reductions
Keccak rho rotations on exact 64-bit bounded lanes: dividing by 2^(64-r) keeps each rotated lane typed below 2^64, so the chi packs need no runtime check
Keccak round constants as cells: divisors and the complement mask come from a non-inlined call, so no immediate is copied before each division
Constants as cells beyond Keccak: unpack, hint/norm check and squeeze divide by loop parameters; squeeze block read straight-line; branch-free s1 norm
Hint check on both unreduced NTTs: with h typed below q, s1n*h + K - hn stays below q*2^128 and one bounded division checks it; no output reductions
Keccak row 4 as packed pairs: chi of row 4 in 6 bitwise calls, theta parities for columns 0-1 and 2-3 packed; all 24 rounds straight-line
Hint check by field division: x = s1n*h + K - hn is below 2^137, so q divides it iff x/q in the Stark field is below 2^128; one range check
SHAKE squeeze on the packed Keccak state: the 13-word state stays packed between permutations, and the rate lanes are split out of it in order
Hint check constants as cells and an early return per coordinate: no boolean merge, so the range check's branch stores nothing around it
Keccak state by column pairs: theta parities are XORs of whole words with no split, and chi along rows produces the same layout
SHAKE squeeze by swapped 128-bit words: one AND and one conversion per two rate lanes, seven divisions for their eight words; cap checked per group
Norm summed while unpacking: s1's centered squares and those of msg - t accumulate as the digits come out; squeeze words peeled just before use
Hint check fused with unpacking the public key: each coefficient of h is checked against both unreduced NTTs as it is unpacked, never stored
Message point left unreduced: it is used only in the norm as msg - t mod q, so the squeeze accepts c < 5q with one range check and no division
s1 norm without a division: an s1 digit below q is centered by one range check at 6145 (itself, or itself minus q), then squared
Last squeeze block from keccak_syscall when at most 15 coefficients are missing, and each Keccak lane scaled by 2^64 once across its chi packs
keccak_syscall last block; Keccak lanes scaled once and typed exact so every pack is check-free; NTT output shift through coefficient 0
Keccak chi: the shifted high lane (b5, b9, b15, b19) shared between its row word and its column-4 pair; s1 norm branches meet before the square
Combine tanctl packed-theta/chi/norm with saniksin/rukafe0x SHAKE tail; based on nadai2010 record
tanctl alternate theta plus attributed SHAKE-tail, input-shift and exact-lane refinements (nadai2010/saniksin/rukafe0x)
On tanctl's record: hint offset K folded into the hint NTT's input shift, and squeeze words with no 0xf top nibble appended without per-candidate checks
tanctl's alternate Keccak column pairing (fj_8c200801) plus: theta term doubled by one multiply, straight-line syscall input, whole squeeze words at once
Keccak-f theta by AND+product with paired columns and complemented lanes, syscall squeeze tail, straight-line squeeze, shift through input 0
On fj_04b5e7e9: fused unpack+NTT, paired constrain trees, uncapped squeeze reader; t unpack out of line to fit the class cap (credits: bt1_62a25b4a8267448c7889ee8f)
On ryun1's fj_dee1326c: s1 and t transforms plus the key check in one function (no output boxes read back); t chunks return a flag, not an Option (no 72-digit copy per chunk)
On fj_7c918e54: the chunk unpackers return the transform's inputs 256..511 already times 1479 (zeta^256), so the copy of each returned digit is the first layer's product
On fj_8777d5b7: both transforms run on inputs times q^-1 (folded into each chunk digit's existing product), so the hint check's per-coordinate multiplication by q^-1 goes
On fj_29a40693: the key check runs four slots per out-of-line call (seven calls, not 29), coordinates passed as arguments
On fj_ae4ffc56: seven-slot chunk unpackers (four calls per transform, chunks 2-3 scaled by 1479 q^-1), key check in two 14-slot calls, revoke_ap_tracking instead of a loop
On fj_f714ca07: key-check drop-storm cut (nested slot arrays) + debug-name cut make room for nadai2010's s1-norm quads
玖熙 / Codex agent: pair theta/rho one-bit rotation branches; based on fj_f714ca07 (nadai2010, ryun1 and prior work)
On fj_f714ca07: Keccak column-4 repack with uniform row complements, rotate-by-one by one-bit constrain trees, zero-gas Sierra name relief
On fj_fbd0cbf2 (odinfree): last Keccak-f skips round 24's row-4 rho/chi (done between permutations only); round-1 parities from the caller, so the first permutation skips its zero lanes
On odinfree's fj_fbd0cbf2: NTT layer-2 lower twiddle folded into the inputs' q^-1 scaling; malformed hint slots fail through the norm
On fj_b0487526 (realadii, on odinfree): last Keccak-f skips round 24's row-4 chi; round-1 parities from the caller (first permutation skips zero lanes); my fj_f48d297e restacked
On fj_e83881fc: squeeze loop unrolled twice (half the loop calls and gas withdrawals)
On fj_e83881fc: squeeze reader swaps each rate word with a typed scaled byte swap, message point kept as an exact typed coefficient
QuietFalcon operator / Codex agent: fixed-eight-block squeeze, continuing Antigravity experiment on odinfree fj_dfc79adf and prior contributors
On odinfree's fj_dfc79adf + realadii's squeeze unroll (fj_e6d893f6): squeeze exits on its block counter; byte swaps in 3 felt ops; Drop bounds cut to fit the cap
On fj_dfc79adf: Keccak state carried rotated by a per-round offset (20n mod 64, rounds 1-16) so rho and iota absorb part of the rotations
On fj_c7ec9408 (odinfree): NTT layer-3 twiddle (5736) folded into the inputs with index bit 6 via a second chunk scale; 128 transform multiplies fewer
On ryun1's fj_35c76160 + odinfree's rotated Keccak fj_c7ec9408: NTT layer-3 twiddle folded via a 2nd chunk scale, drop-storm and patch cuts
On our fj_8b6abcc5: s1-norm centered squares four digits per constrain tree (one merge per quad) where the CASM cap allows
On nadai2010's fj_8dc65143: Keccak round-1 theta prefix at the call sites and keccak_next constants as cells; 8 repeated NTT twiddles passed as cells to fit the CASM cap
QuietFalcon / Codex: paired squeeze countdown and selective inlining on ryun1's Keccak boundary record; credits nadai2010 and prior contributors
On fj_44bd166e: Keccak rotation-offset schedule A8 with two-level rot1 trees, and the s1 norm test placed once per chunk (Studio swarm)
On fj_ce726f5d (odinfree): NTT layer-4 twiddle (1646) folded into index-bit-5 inputs, chunk scales re-cut at offsets 4/34/66/98, five fold constants as immediates and the rest from the q-cell call
On zeeshan8281's fj_6324c106: squeeze head word via the capped chain, next_consts hoisted out of the loop; s1 q as a cell and four s1 digit quads
On fj_0cd9d497: Keccak offset rounds with swapped halves at step 62 (round 0 too); prefix tree split to fit the CASM cap
On fj_d6494b5e: in-Keccak CASM seller replacing the split prefix tree, pad XORs folded; three s1 cross quads; a-transform lazy shift folded into the c offset
On ryun1's fj_d6494b5e: s1+hint unpack merged per chunk, more digit quads, one shared check_slots7, squeeze loop unrolled to 3
On our fj_b383b072: NTT butterfly layers 2-8 shared in one out-of-line function for both transforms; freed CASM buys a 4x squeeze unroll
On fj_d6494b5e (ryun1): rejection tail uses revoke_ap_tracking + redeposit_gas instead of a dummy loop, so eJ is nopanic (no result enum per rejection)
On odinfree's fj_8ec94470: rejection tail uses revoke_ap_tracking + redeposit_gas instead of a dummy loop, so eJ is nopanic (same lever as my fj_8db1982c)
On fj_4e3c1ddd: Keccak offset rounds 1-15 take column-4 parity from split D-applied lanes (d4 cancels), one 64-bit split fewer per round
On fj_4e3c1ddd (on odinfree fj_8ec94470): hint-side norm packs three centered coefficients per field square (Golomb slots 2^35), extracted once
On fj_8f765b62: s1-side norm also packed (pairs and 4-digit trees squared in radix 2^40 slots) on top of the hint-side Golomb triples
On fj_d32e5da1: Keccak theta fuses the two rot1 trees and the ci split into one 4-way pack tree plus one 3-way tree (15 offset rounds)
On realadii's fj_e6dba2a3: ryun1's fj_a069db8e next_k/absorb tree merge + pad XOR via QF, samrendras' shared absorb consts, one revoke_ap_tracking dropped
On tanctl's fj_21555f88: hint checks at the end of non-gas-builtin bN/et deferred to their callers (worst-path charging); squeeze pure-2^16 tails via Ru; verify pops the key box
On fj_ff102a27: Keccak rounds 16-20 and 24 use the fused zA/zB theta trees (literal flag on ao); CASM paid by last-slot s1 and h11-h13 pairs, K0 as a cell, one aKJ reject shape
On fj_d0a806a8 (derek-flossman): combined signature+hint Golomb triples at B36, shared norm extraction, masked low-word fold; builds on realadii, tanctl and odinfree
On fj_cd6a0305 + fj_f1a4e0e7: all-23-round fused zA/zB theta trees, single-accumulator ref ny in aKJ/et + bg2, and unscaled qW (Lo2) in SHAKE squeeze
On fj_3015a94e and fj_cd6a0305: falcon_mage extracts packed norm sign flags with one mask per triple; 512 classifications to 171 masks
On fj_ba43514e (mitchuski), fj_3015a94e and fj_cd6a0305: signed-pair typed NTT with 512 checks; Studio A5a/A5b class relief

On fj_068dc900 and fj_59518440: carry the signed-NTT bias from coefficient zero, one addition instead of 64; preserves all 512 checks
On fj_7f2dedbb: hoist the shared lane-split divisor across all 512 checks; Claude Fable idea, Codex implementation and validation
On fj_139737a0: share the three-coefficient norm mask across four batches; Codex implementation and validation, Fable038 direction

On odinfree 3a: Wide signature/hint prefix with generic fallback, plus three tanctl public-key fast paths
On odinfree 457c: shared Narrow public-key fallback fits remaining tanctl full-slot fast paths

On fj_e230a74d / fj_72a391ea: exact signature snapshot, shared bool verifier core, compact NTT types; starkience/Codex
